summary: DocGo Inc. filed an 8-K dated October 1, 2026, updating its previously announced August 16, 2026 merger of MergerCo into Hicuity Health, Inc., which will survive as a wholly owned subsidiary of DocGo's Ambulnz Holdings unit; terms were not restated in this excerpt. Concurrently, Hicuity and Ambulnz entered an amended and restated credit agreement with Perceptive Credit Holdings IV as administrative agent, continuing $52.0 million Term Loan A and adding $12.5 million Term Loan B. A consulting agreement has Ambulnz managing Hicuity's non-clinical operations pre-close. Watch financing conditions and closing timing for deal risk.
